<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 1+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Bristling Spines](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3179)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Graft" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=790" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 97

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** implanted

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Your exposed skin is covered in fine, needle-like hairs that you can flick into the eyes of enemies.

**Activate—Urticating Burst** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You flick tiny spines in a 15-foot cone, dealing the listed amount of piercing damage to all creatures in the area with a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure, the creature is also [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) until the end of their next turn.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 1"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bristling Spines (Lesser)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 97

**Price** 15 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The DC is 15 and the spines deal 1d8 damage.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bristling Spines (Moderate)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 97

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The DC is 18 and the spines deal 2d8 damage.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 7"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bristling Spines (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 97

**Price** 360 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The DC is 23 and the spines deal 5d8 damage. Instead of being [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) on a critical failure, the target is instead [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=59) until the end of their next turn.
name: Bristling Spines (Moderate)
